classical_xgboost.description: Gradient boosted decision trees trained on 22 acoustic features

quantum_vqc.description: Variational quantum classifier with ZZFeatureMap and RealAmplitudes ansatz

meta_classifier.name: Experiment C2: Stacking Meta-Classifier
meta_classifier.description: Logistic regression stacking meta-model on [P_classical, P_quantum]

scientific_conclusion: Classical XGBoost demonstrates high sensitivity on 22 acoustic features (ROC-AUC 1.0 on test split). The 4-qubit Quantum VQC achieves 0.697 ROC-AUC via non-linear quantum angle encoding. The Hybrid Fusion combines classical and quantum representations with optimal weights alpha=0.31, beta=0.69.
